questions.prompt: What does the .py extension tell your computer?
choices: That the file contains Python source code
That the file will run automatically at startup
questions.explain: The extension is how your editor and the interpreter recognise the file as Python.

choices: Editing, running and debugging your code in one place
questions.explain: An IDE bundles the editor, the run button and the debugger together so you are not switching tools constantly.

questions.prompt: You type python --version and get 'command not found'. What is the most likely cause?
choices: Your code has a syntax error
Python is not installed, or is not on your PATH
Your file is missing the .py extension
You need to restart your computer
questions.explain: That message comes from the shell, before Python is involved at all, so it is about installation rather than your code.
